title: Seven Masters Fell. The Inn Boy Returned.
subtitle: The Masters from Fifteen Years Ahead Are Fighting in His Head
author: Nitty Gritty Novel Lab
description: Fifteen years after the Heavenly Demon Divine Cult conquers the martial world, seven grandmasters spend their lives on one final return—not for any of themselves, but for Ryu Dan, the neutral inn worker they all trust. Back in his twenty-year-old body, Ryu must awaken their argumentative future echoes, change their younger living selves, and build the alliance their factions failed to become.
eyebrow: A MURIM REGRESSION NOVEL · VOLUME ONE
genre: Wuxia · One-time regression · Master ensemble · Coalition progression
quote: Seven masters could not save the world. So they entrusted their last return to an inn boy.
about: Caught between seven perfected masters from a dead future and the younger people they once were, a sectless inn worker must join martial arts, relationships, and institutions without erasing their differences.
completion_text: Two guest rooms are open, and Return Inn now holds the martial world's first jointly governed antidote ledger.
